title_en: ★Korean Language Examination for International Students – Thesis Submission Qualification Examination, Fall Semester 2026
summary: Graduate international students may pass the foreign language part of the Thesis Submission Qualification Examination by taking the Korean language examination, completing a designated Korean language course, or submitting an English test score. For Fall 2026, applications for the Korean examination and English score reports are accepted from 24 to 28 August 2026, and the written Korean examination is held on 18 September 2026.
applies_to: Graduate international students who must pass the foreign language examination of the Thesis Submission Qualification Examination. Integrated master's-doctoral students take the examination at the doctoral level. The English score option is available only to international students for whom English is not a native, common or official language; students for whom English is a native, common or official language may only take the Korean language examination or the Korean language course.

translation:
★Korean Language Examination for International Students – Thesis Submission Qualification Examination, Fall Semester 2026

Announcement of the Foreign Language Examination for International Students' Thesis Submission Qualification (Including Korean)

To pass the foreign language examination of the Thesis Submission Qualification Examination, a graduate international student may choose one of the following three methods.

Ⅰ. Take the Korean language examination: held by the Seoul National University Office of Academic Affairs every semester in March and September.
Ⅱ. Take a Korean language course: [한국어와 한국문화1] (Korean Language and Korean Culture 1) or [한국어와 한국문화2] (Korean Language and Korean Culture 2).
Ⅲ. Submit an English test score: New TEPS or TOEFL (iBT).

Ⅰ. Taking the Korean Language Examination
Refer to Attachment 1 (2026-2 Semester Korean Language Examination Plan and Application Form).

1. Submission of the application form
A. Submission period: Monday 24 August 2026 – Friday 28 August 2026 ★Check the dates!!
B. Submission method: Complete and print the application form (see Attachment 1) → sign it yourself and obtain your supervisor's signature (or seal) → submit it to the staff member in charge at the department administrative office (Building 301, Room 319).

2. Korean language examination (written test)
A. Examination date: Friday 18 September 2026, 9:30–10:30 (60 minutes). ※ Be seated in your assigned seat at the examination venue by 9:20.
B. Examination venue: Building 39, Room B103.

3. Notes
A. Bring your student ID card or identity card (Alien Registration Card).
B. Students in the integrated master's-doctoral programme take the examination as doctoral students.
※ If you wish to take the Korean language examination as an oral test, please make an enquiry by email (the address is given in the original notice).

Ⅱ. Taking a Korean Language Course
1. You take a course that substitutes for the Thesis Submission Qualification Examination. However, its credits are not counted toward the credits required for completion of coursework.
2. Course names: [한국어와 한국문화 1] (Korean Language and Korean Culture 1), [한국어와 한국문화 2] (Korean Language and Korean Culture 2).
3. If you obtain a grade of C- or above, or S, you are exempted from the Korean language examination.
※ You must take the course before the semester in which you complete your coursework.

Ⅲ. Submitting an English Test Score
Refer to Attachment 2 (Minimum English Scores for the Thesis Submission Qualification Examination).
1. International students for whom English is not a native language, common language or official language submit their English test score report to the staff member in charge at the department administrative office (Building 301, Room 319).
★The score must not be past its validity period (within 2 years).
2. English test score report submission period: Monday 24 August 2026 – Friday 28 August 2026 ★Check the dates!!
3. Minimum scores: see Attachment 2!!
4. International students for whom English is a native language, common language or official language may only take the Korean language examination or the Korean language course.

<Attachments>
1. 2026-2 Semester Korean Language Examination Plan and Application Form
2. Minimum English Scores for the Thesis Submission Qualification Examination

● Enquiries: Department administrative office (Building 301, Room 319). The staff member's name and email address are given in the original notice.
If you leave your question by email, it will be answered in order within 1–2 days.

[The original notice also contains an English version of the same content below the Korean text. That version contains errors (for example, it refers to the "2022-2 semester" in the title of Attachment 1); this translation follows the Korean text.]

Attached files (2): 1. 논문제출자격시험 영어과목 기준 점수.pdf (Minimum English Scores); 2. 2026-2학기 한국어시험 실시 계획(공지용).hwp (2026-2 Korean Language Examination Plan). The contents of these attachments, including the application form and the minimum English scores, were not read and are not included here.
